Review Title: IMPRESSIVE...and I have severe allergies!  But there are some issues with shipping....
Review: I care for a 99yo relative who has urinary incontinence.  I have an adult diaper pail that works well, however in the summer heat it has been horribly smelly...even with the scent abosorbing bag liner.  Emptying said pail has been almost too much to endure, until I found ByeBye Odor.  I just open up the door and spray one pump and give it a couple of minutes to work...voila, no smell.This same person has irritable bowel syndrome and gets horrible bouts of diarrhea that permeate the entire house.  At least it use to, thanks to ByeBye Odor we can all breath deeply during these situations.I have severe allergies and get sinus infections easily, even from perfumes.  Febreze makes me sick because it's to highly perfumed and it lingers for days.  I am also a super smeller, meaning I can smell odors/scents that others cannot.  ByeBye Odor does have a mildtropical-fruity scent that dissipates quickly...and I don't end up tasting it all day.The only problem I have with this product is the bottles leaked during shipping, therefore only 4 stars.  In my first shipment the bottles leaked so badly that I couldn't even bring the box or bottles into the house.  The lids were unscrewed and almost one whole bottle leaked out.  There was mild leakage with the replacement shipment too.  All three bottle have label damage from the leakage.Amazon could pack the product better with pillow packing so the bottles do not rub against the paper packing and box.  But apparently they believe their "green packaging'" is more climate friendly than repeated returns and replacement deliveries.  Additionally the manufacturer should put a tamper proof tape around the bottom of the lid to deter leakage.  I believe both companies need to pay attention to these issues because when consumers buy items like ByeBye Odor they have an immediate need.I can really feel for Amazon's employees that have to smell this product all day in their vans because it has leaked out and soaked the boxes....

Review: This is a lubricant to be put in bag and over the stoma. It prevents your liquid stool from sitting on top of stoma and not moving. This “not moving of stoma waste” can push the liquid out under the flange and any other extra taping. It doesn’t matter if the insides of the pouch is completely covered, the lubricant that is sitting on the stoma will also connect to drainage and help it along. I use this every time I drain my pouch. I have no problem with odor as the pouch is closed again after rinsing and there is no odor when closed and no one has ever complained about me smelling. I go into my bathroom alone. I keep a large plastic bottle filled with water next to my toilet. I keep all my cleaning up supplies in a basket . Review Title: The best I have tried for directing the solids away from my stoma! Very easy to empty bag now 😁!
Review: I had been having trouble with the output staying around where it comes out preventing further pieces from getting past the one sometimes more, lodged around the stoma. I had tried several brands that did nothing but turn everything brown and liquid at the neck where we open to entry. But they did nothing for the new stuff up top of the bag, causing what I’ve now figured out that’s what seasoned Ostomates call “pancaking”. Plus, this also seems to keep the stoma from sucking the plastic bag into it, also blocking the pathway for subsequent output. I can still smell the poop ONLY when I empty into the toilet and it doesn’t smell as strong anymore. My husband has never been able to smell it but he doesn’t have the “Blood Hound” smeller I do-thank God! And it’s just the two of us living in our house. My biggest problem was the difficulty getting the stuff out of the bag, especially when I start to back up and have to use something like Miralax. That makes it really sticky and almost impossible for me to shake it out, usually having to dig way up into the mess and pull it out! So disgusting and embarrassing when my husband has to help me pour water into the top of the bag to wash it out! I have decided to just throw the whole bag away when it gets like that! But this product helps with that too. And like I said it’s the best brand for the money I have found. Good luck and may God give peace to all who have to deal with this!

Review Title: Na Scent vs. M9 -- My Experience
Review: I use Na Scent because it works best for my ileostomy.  I have tried M9, which works better for complete odor elimination, and only requires 3-4 drops instead of a big squirt at each empty.  But I'm happier with Na Scent because after about day 3, the M9 (which looks and smells exactly like RV-Blue) starts making your bag smell like an RV toilet every time you open it.  And the longer you go without a bag-change, the more the M9 chemical smell builds-up.  I find that repulsive.  In case you don't know, an ileostomy is a very stinky location to terminate the digestive tract.  And it's a smell that hangs around for a very long time and elicits much complaining from family members.  The Na Scent product does not eliminate this odor completely like M9.  But it doesn't add it's own repulsive chemical smell ever.  And a good squirt after each emptying knocks the odor back to no worse than my typical pre-surgery output.  My bathroom fan is broken, so I just open the door and within a few minutes any smell is gone.  No more complaints from others (or myself).  You can order free samples from the Na Scent website ($5 shipping) and give it a try.  Keep both those sample bottles for later use in your travel bag.  The one complaint I do have about Na Scent is that it takes so much product to work well, especially if you're eating fast-food or pepperoni pizzas.  My insurance allows x3 12 oz. bottles per month.  And I keep finding myself running low by the end of each month.  Which is why I'm on here buying more.  I hope you can apply my experience to your situation to figure-out which one is best for you.

Review: I have used the Assure C odor eliminator and I liked it well enough to order it from Amazon.  The product information defaults to the "blue" type of odor eliminator.  I have never seen an odor eliminator that is blue in color, so I admit I didn't see that.  When I received it and went to open the bottle I saw that there was a warning that it was blue in color and might stain!  What?  Why on earth would they even think of producing an ostomy odor eliminator that was blue and might stain!  What possible purpose could the coloring have?  A bad thing for me - as I could not imagine that this product was blue and might stain, is that the site defaults to the blue color product.I will be keeping both bottles - probably throwing them out actually - although I only opened one, as the information was there.  To me  having a colored odor eliminator makes no sense, and as the site defaults to the blue color, I made a big mistake.  I do like the clear Assure C.  I just wanted to give other potential purchasers a heads-up that they need to change the selection to the "clear" type of eliminator or they will end up with useless products the way I have.
